groups.name: Lockdown
groups.idea: Root a target; Viper's Ambush and Gunner's Snipe hit it half again as hard.

groups.name: Called Shot
groups.idea: Mark a target; Anchor's Groundswell and Talon's Execute hit it half again as hard, on top of the mark.

groups.name: Wildfire
groups.idea: Set the line alight; Lens's Lance and Mortar's Barrage hit burning targets half again as hard.

groups.name: Venom
groups.idea: Viper poisons for Briar's Bloom, and Briar roots for Viper's Ambush: a two-way pair.

groups.name: Smother
groups.idea: Exhaust an enemy; Ember's Wildfire hits it half again as hard.

groups.name: Crush
groups.idea: Walls give Tempest's Gust something to slam enemies into.
